notes: 'even from' is the preposition's whole rendering under rule 16, as כַּחוֹל → 'even as' is: the word stands before the object of the very preposition written beside it, and no conjunction stands in the phrase to take a bare 'even'. The competing appositional reading, which would leave 'even' added, is named in the unit note.
הַמֶּלֶךְ is rendered 'king Hezekiah' with no 'the', so its article is unrepresented under rule 29's last sentence.
